title: bus.system.pressure v1
description: Host resource-pressure state transitions from the system-pressure adapter: filesystem fill levels, runaway directory growth, and systemd unit restart storms. Motivating incident (2026-08-30): hearth/.beads/backup wrote ~280G in a 2h window (per-write dolt backup sync amplified by a poller comment loop) and filled /home to 100%, while beads-dolt.service crash-looped through 800 restarts — both invisible until sessions started failing on ENOSPC. Emitted ONLY on level transitions (ok→warn→critical and recovery) plus a bounded re-reminder for sustained pressure, never per-poll. Consumers: deer-flow SSE, zjstatus, and bus.notify fan-out for critical levels.

host.description: Hostname the measurement was taken on.

kind.description: Pressure dimension: filesystem fill percentage, watched-directory growth rate, or systemd user-unit restart storm.

key.description: The subject: a mountpoint (`/home`), a watched directory path, or a systemd unit name.

level.description: New pressure level after this transition.

prev_level.description: Level before this transition; `unknown` on first observation.

summary.description: One-sentence human-readable statement of the condition, e.g. `/home at 96% (41G free)` or `hearth/.beads/backup growing 38.2 GB/h`.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the measurement.

used_pct.description: For kind=disk: percent of the filesystem used.

size_bytes.description: For kind=dir_growth: current directory size in bytes.

growth_gb_per_hour.description: For kind=dir_growth: measured growth rate since the previous poll (negative = shrinking).

restarts.description: For kind=unit_restarts: the unit's cumulative NRestarts counter.

restart_delta.description: For kind=unit_restarts: restarts added since the previous poll.

active_state.description: For kind=unit_restarts: systemd ActiveState at measurement time.
